descriptionChirho: The underworld or abode of the dead in Hebrew cosmology, variously rendered as Sheol, Hades, the grave, or the pit; all prepositional and construct-state forms (to-Sheol, in-Sheol, from-Sheol, like-Sheol, of-Sheol) refer to this single concept of the netherworld destination of the deceased.
A verbal form (Qal imperative) meaning to ask or make a request, likely a homographic overlap with the verb sha'al; semantically unrelated to the noun Sheol.
